functionalRequirement: The system shall provide a calendar view of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display all available appointment slots for each healthcare provider for 100% of the specified time periods.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a comprehensive view of appointment availability, necessitating complete coverage of all relevant time slots.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must render the calendar view of available appointment slots within 200 milliseconds for up to 500 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A quick response time is essential for user satisfaction when accessing appointment information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The calendar view must be intuitive and easy to navigate for users, allowing them to find available slots within 3 clicks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that users should be able to easily interact with the calendar to find appointments without extensive training.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The calendar view must be accessible and functional 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need consistent access to appointment slots, which is critical for planning their visits.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to search for properties based on specific criteria such as location, area, and number of bedrooms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The search functionality must allow filtering by all specified criteria (location, area, number of bedrooms) for 100% of the property listings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive search capabilities, ensuring all relevant criteria are supported.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 3 seconds for queries involving up to 1,000 property listings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Fast search results are essential for user satisfaction and engagement when looking for properties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide tooltips or help text for each search criterion to assist users in understanding how to effectively use the search.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR indicates a need for user support in the search process, enhancing usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The search feature must gracefully handle invalid input criteria by providing user-friendly error messages without crashing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensuring that users can correct their inputs without system failure is crucial for maintaining a reliable user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that user search queries are logged securely and anonymized to protect user privacy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: User search data can be sensitive, and protecting this information is essential for maintaining trust.
